game.name: Jillian Michaels Fitness Adventure (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc: Jillian Michaels' Fitness Adventure invites us this time to move our bodies exclusively on Xbox 360. Thanks to Kinect's advanced motion detection, the famous coach will be able to take us on a real expedition through the jungle while we do various series of exercises designed to keep us in shape.
